units.source_text: 紫夫人答道：“在旁人看来，固然如你所说，我这微不足道之身，享受了过分的幸福。

en.t: Lady Murasaki replied, "To others, just as you say, this insignificant life of mine must seem to have enjoyed excessive happiness.

units.source_text: 谁知我心中一向怀着难于堪忍的痛苦呢。

en.t: But who could know that my heart has always carried a pain almost impossible to bear?

units.source_text: 为此我自己常向神佛祈祷。”

en.t: That is why I myself have so often prayed to the gods and Buddhas."

units.source_text: 脉脉含情，似乎还有许多话要说的样子。

en.t: Her gaze was full of feeling, as though she still had many things left to say.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“老实对你说吧：我自己觉得余命已经不多，今年倘再因循过去，将来后悔莫及。

en.t: After a while she said again, "Let me speak honestly to you: I feel that little of my life remains, and if I let this year pass by in delay, regret will come too late.

units.source_text: 我早就立下誓愿，务请你允许我出家吧。”

en.t: I made this vow long ago, so please, I beg you, allow me to take the tonsure."

units.source_text: 源氏说：“此事千万不可！

en.t: Genji said, "That must absolutely not happen!

units.source_text: 你遁入空门，把我抛弃在世间，我还有什么生趣呢？

en.t: If you enter the Buddhist life and leave me abandoned in this world, what joy in living would remain for me?

units.source_text: 你我共处，虽然只是度送平凡的岁月，然而朝夕相对，心心相印，正是莫大的乐趣。

en.t: Even if our life together is only the passing of ordinary days, to face each other morning and evening with our hearts in accord is the greatest happiness.

units.source_text: 还望你详察我对你特别怜爱的真心。”

en.t: I hope you will look deeply into the sincere heart with which I cherish you above all others."

units.source_text: 每次要求，他总是阻止，紫夫人心绪怏怏，流下泪来。

en.t: Whenever she made this request, he always stopped her, and Lady Murasaki, disheartened, shed tears.

units.source_text: 源氏看看她的模样，觉得非常可怜，便百般安慰她。

en.t: Seeing her like this, Genji felt deeply sorry for her and comforted her in every possible way.

units.source_text: 后来对她说道：“我所看到的女子并不多，然据我所见，虽然各人姿色各有优点，并非全无可取，但熟悉之后，便会相信真正性情稳重、态度安详的人，实在不易多得。

en.t: Later he said to her, "I have not known a great many women, but from what I have seen, although each has her own merits of beauty and grace and none is without something admirable, once one comes to know them well, one realizes how rare it is to find a woman truly steady in character and serene in bearing.

units.source_text: 譬如夕雾的母亲，是我年轻时候最初相逢的女子，出身于高贵之家，与我有结发之缘。

en.t: For example, Yugiri's mother was the first woman I met in my youth; she came from a noble house and was bound to me as my lawful wife.

units.source_text: 然而我和她的感情始终不洽，两心疏远隔膜，直到她死为止。

en.t: Yet my feelings and hers were never in harmony, and our two hearts remained distant and divided until her death.

units.source_text: 今日思之，不胜愧悔。

en.t: When I think of it now, I am overcome with shame and regret.

units.source_text: 我回想当时情状，自心觉得不仅是我一人的罪过。

en.t: When I recall how things were then, I cannot help feeling that the fault was not mine alone.

units.source_text: 此人态度庄重严肃，这原不能说是缺陷。

en.t: Her manner was dignified and solemn, and that in itself could not be called a fault.

units.source_text: 只是全无亲昵之趣，终日一本正经，可说是个过分规矩的女子。

en.t: But she had no warmth of intimacy at all and was serious all day long, a woman one might call excessively proper.

units.source_text: 照理推想，此人十分可靠；但对面相处，只觉沉闷难堪。

en.t: Judged by reason, she was certainly very dependable; but when I was with her face to face, I only found it unbearably dull.

units.source_text: 再举一人：秋好皇后的母亲，品貌与众不同。

en.t: To name another: the mother of Empress Akikonomu was exceptional in both character and beauty.

units.source_text: 欲求情趣丰富、姿态艳雅的范例，则首先想起此人。

en.t: If one wanted an example of rich sensibility and elegant charm, she would be the first person to come to mind.

units.source_text: 然而脾气古怪，难于亲近。

en.t: Yet her temperament was difficult, and she was hard to approach.

units.source_text: 女子心中偶有怨恨，原是合乎情理之事，但她长记在心，固执不忘，以致怨恨越来越深，真乃痛苦之事！

en.t: It is only natural that resentment may sometimes arise in a woman's heart, but she kept it there for a long time, stubbornly refusing to forget, until the resentment grew ever deeper; it was truly painful.

units.source_text: 和她相处，须得时时留意，谨慎小心。

en.t: To live with her, one had to remain constantly attentive and cautious.

units.source_text: 倘欲彼此无所顾忌、朝夕相亲，似乎颇有不便之处。

en.t: If one wished for the two of us to be at ease with each other and intimate from morning to night, there seemed to be many difficulties.

units.source_text: 如果对她开诚解怀，深恐被她看轻；过分谨慎小心，结果遂成疏隔。

en.t: If I opened my heart frankly to her, I feared she would look down on me; if I was overly careful, the result was estrangement.

units.source_text: 她流传了不贞的罪名，遭受了轻薄的讥评，常常悲叹懊恼，原是怪可怜的。

en.t: A charge of unfaithfulness was spread about her, and she suffered frivolous criticism; she often lamented and grieved, and she was indeed pitiable.

units.source_text: 我想起了她的一生，痛感自己罪无可逭。

en.t: When I think of her life, I feel keenly that there is no escaping my own guilt.

units.source_text: 为了赎罪，我便竭力照顾她的女儿。

en.t: To atone for it, I did everything I could to care for her daughter.

units.source_text: 虽说这女儿自有身为皇后的宿命，但毕竟还靠我不顾世人讥评，不怕朋辈妒恨，鼎力提拔，方得成功。

en.t: Although that daughter may have had the destiny to become empress, in the end her success came because I ignored public criticism, feared no envy from my peers, and supported her with all my strength.

units.source_text: 她在九泉之下，也应恕我无罪了。

en.t: She, beneath the nine springs, should now forgive me and hold me guiltless.

units.source_text: 在现今，在往昔，我都由于放荡不羁，做下了许多教别人受苦、使自己后悔的事。”

en.t: Both now and in the past, because of my unruly self-indulgence, I have done many things that made others suffer and left me with regret."

units.source_text: 他略微谈谈这两个故人的事。

en.t: He spoke briefly about these two women who had passed away.

units.source_text: 随后又说：“皇上的女御的那个保护人，出身并不高贵。

en.t: Then he went on, "The guardian of His Majesty's consort was not of noble birth.

units.source_text: 起初我小看她，认为无足轻重。

en.t: At first I looked down on her and thought her of no importance.

units.source_text: 岂知此人修养功夫极深，心不见底。

en.t: But who could have known that her cultivation was so profound and that the depths of her heart could not be seen?

units.source_text: 表面上低声下气，百依百从，而心中秘藏着高远的见识，令人不知不觉地赞叹呢。”

en.t: Outwardly she was humble and compliant in every way, yet within her heart she concealed lofty insight, making one admire her before one even realized it."

units.source_text: 紫夫人说：“别的人我不曾见过，不得而知。

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "I have not met the others, so I cannot know.

units.source_text: 这位明石夫人呢，虽然不很熟识，却是常常见面的。

en.t: As for Lady Akashi, although I do not know her very well, I do see her often.

units.source_text: 我看她的模样，觉得实在可佩，心中赞叹不已。

en.t: When I look at her bearing, I find her truly admirable, and in my heart my admiration never ceases.

units.source_text: 像我这种心直口快的人，不知她看了作何感想，我很担心呢。

en.t: I worry what she must think when she sees someone like me, so direct in heart and speech.

units.source_text: 好在女御深知我心，总会向她解说的吧。”

en.t: Fortunately, the consort understands my heart well, and surely she will explain it to her."

units.source_text: 紫夫人本来非常嫌恶明石夫人，很疏远她，现在却如此赞许她，和她亲近。

en.t: Lady Murasaki had once greatly disliked Lady Akashi and kept her at a distance, but now she praised her in this way and drew close to her.

units.source_text: 源氏知道这全是由于她真心疼爱女御之故。

en.t: Genji knew that this was entirely because she sincerely loved the consort.

units.source_text: 他十分感谢她的好意，对她说道：“你虽然心中不能没有蕴藏，但你善于因人因事而运用亲疏两种态度。

en.t: He was deeply grateful for her kindness and said to her, "Although you surely have feelings hidden in your heart, you are skilled at using both closeness and distance according to the person and the situation.

units.source_text: 我阅人多矣，却从来不曾见过像你这样能干的人。

en.t: I have known many people, but I have never seen anyone as capable as you.

units.source_text: 你真是个特殊人物。”

en.t: You truly are an extraordinary person."

units.source_text: 他说时面露笑容。

en.t: As he said this, a smile appeared on his face.

units.source_text: 后来又说：“此次三公主的琴弹得很好，我该去称赞她几句。”

en.t: Later he added, "This time the Third Princess played the koto very well; I ought to go and say a few words of praise to her."

units.source_text: 便在傍晚时分走到三公主那里去了。

en.t: So at dusk he went over to the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 三公主丝毫没有想到世间有妒忌她的人，全同小孩一般，专心学习弹琴。

en.t: The Third Princess had not the slightest thought that anyone in the world might envy her, and like a child she devoted herself entirely to learning the koto.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说道：“今天放假，让我休息吧。

en.t: Genji said to her, "Let us take a holiday today, and let me rest.

units.source_text: 学生应该体恤老师。

en.t: A student ought to show consideration for her teacher.

units.source_text: 这几天教你弹琴，真辛苦呢！

en.t: Teaching you the koto these past few days has truly been hard work!

units.source_text: 现在可以放心了。”

en.t: Now I can be at ease."

units.source_text: 便把琴推开，解衣就寝。

en.t: Then he pushed the koto aside, loosened his robes, and went to bed.
